title: Associate - Fund Administration (Fund Accounting) - Hedge Daily
description:
This role is based in our office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
As an Associate, you
will
report to the Senior Associate Director.

The Associate
is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial data thorough reconciliations and detailed reporting for complex fund structures. This role requires a deep understanding of portfolio systems and involves collaboration with various internal teams to support client deliverables, manage system upgrades, and maintain operational efficiency.

From a high-level perspective, the core responsibilities that form your role are broken down into the following 8 categories:

1. Reconciliation and Reporting

2. Data Management and Query Resolution

3. Client Communication

4. System Management and Upgrades

5. Operational Support

6. Client Implementation Support

7. Continuous Improvement

8. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities

Your Daily Tasks

The following are the tasks linked to the Core Responsibilities that will be expected as part of this role:

1. Reconciliation and Reporting:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a. Comprehensive Reconciliations: Conduct thorough reconciliations of cash, positions, interests, expenses, and corporate actions, comparing data from clients, brokers, custodians, and other sources.

b. Detailed Reporting: Generate and support T+1 reconciliations for clients, ensuring that cash, market value, security-related events, and corporate actions align between our Portfolio System and counterparty information.

c. Development of Templates: Create new reconciliation templates using data management tools to enhance efficiency and accuracy in reporting.

2. Data Management and Query Resolution:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a. Data Monitoring: Assist with data entry and closely monitor trades, prices, and security-related data, addressing and resolving exceptions as needed.

b. System Query Resolution: Tackle system-based queries impacting the accuracy of position and P&L valuations, ensuring timely and effective resolution.

3. Client Communication:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a. Reporting to Clients: Prepare and deliver comprehensive reports to clients on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis as required, ensuring clarity and accuracy.

b. Advocacy and Support: Collaborate with team members to act as advocates for clients within Catalyst, ensuring all deliverables meet the Administration Service Agreement and Service Level Agreements.

4. System Management and Upgrades

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a. System Upgrades Participation: Participate in workstreams focused on system upgrades and maintenance of Advent Geneva and other data management applications.

b. Pricing Workflow Management: Oversee the automated pricing process, troubleshoot issues, and establish new pricing workflows, including setups for MarkIt, BVAL, and other pricing vendors.

5. Operational Support

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a. Operations Delivery Calendar: Maintain the Operations delivery calendar to ensure timely delivery of daily fund administration products and services.

b. Audit Preparation: Assist in managing the year-end audit and financial statement preparation process for all assigned funds, assisting with auditors and internal teams.

c. Board Meeting Reports: Contribute to the preparation of reports for the Fund’s Board of Directors meetings, ensuring all necessary information is presented accurately.

6. Client Implementation Support

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a. Collaboration for System Setups: Work closely with Client Implementation and operations teams to facilitate system setups, interface programming, and portfolio reporting for client deliverables.

7. Continuous Improvement

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a. Ad-Hoc Support: Provide day-to-day support for ad-hoc requests from clients and internal teams, demonstrating a proactive approach to client service.

b. Process Development: Share insights to drive the development of new processes and procedures that enhance business efficiency and support exceptional client service.

c. Industry Awareness: Stay informed about industry, regulatory, and jurisdictional trends that could impact the business, and contribute to the creation and implementation of new products and solutions to meet evolving client needs.

8. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a. Compliance Tasks: Perform routine compliance checks and adhere to company risk and compliance processes and policies.

b. Record Keeping: Maintain organized records of compliance documents and reports.

c. Assistance in Audits: Provide support during internal audits and compliance reviews.

d. Research Support: Assist in research for compliance-related queries and regulatory information.

e. Learning and Development: Engage in learning opportunities to understand compliance principles and regulations.

Additional Strategic Expectations

· Share insights to enable development of new processes and procedures that will create business efficiency and support delivery of client excellence in service.

· Contribute to the creation, development and implementation of new products and solutions to accommodate the businesses continuous changing needs.

· Collaborate cross-functionally with operations staff, business users, project, and implementation managers to achieve desired and elegant solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

Are you getting excited? We
are! B efore
we get too carried away, there are a few requirements you’ll need to check off before you can apply for the position:

· At least 1 - 3 years' experience with offshore Fund Administration or in a similar role.

· BSc or BA, in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or similar field.

· Previous experience with financial derivatives pricing and accounting (desirable).

· Previous experience with data management.

· The candidate must be an energetic professional.

· Innovator & self-starter with high energy and drive.

· Proactive, taking initiative to identify and address challenges before they become problems.

· Effective communicator, able to convey ideas and information clearly and convincingly.

· Fluent in English (writing & speaking).

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

title: Systeemtherapeut
description:
Werken bij Stichting JA! – Dichtbij, Outreachend en Betekenisvol

Bij Stichting JA! staan we midden tussen de inwoners in de wijk. We bieden aanvullende gespecialiseerde jeugdhulp in Amsterdam, Diemen, Uithoorn en Ouder-Amstel, zonder onnodige drempels. Onze aanpak? Outreachend, laagdrempelig en dichtbij, bij gezinnen thuis, op scholen en op alle plekken waar jeugdigen zich bevinden.

In onze multidisciplinaire gebiedsteams bundelen we de krachten met professionals uit verschillende organisaties. Zo zorgen we ervoor dat gezinnen snel en effectief de juiste ondersteuning krijgen. Geen hulpvraag is hetzelfde, en dát maakt ons werk dynamisch, uitdagend en ontzettend waardevol.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je wordt onderdeel van een gedreven gebiedsteams in de regio {VUL IN}

Samen met psychiaters, (GZ-)psychologen, orthopedagogen(-generalisten), systeemtherapeuten, jeugd- en gezinscoaches en IAG-ers werk je aan complexe hulpvragen. We kijken juist niet alleen naar problemen, maar vooral naar de kracht en veerkracht van elk gezin.

Waarom kiezen voor Stichting JA!?

  • Dichtbij en betrokken: Je bent aanwezig in de wijk en staat letterlijk naast gezinnen.
  • Systemisch werken: Alleen door systemisch te werken, komen we samen tot duurzame oplossingen.
  • Maatwerk : Geen standaardoplossingen, maar hulp die écht past.
  • Sterk netwerk: Samenwerken met specialisten uit verschillende disciplines.
  • Ruimte om te groeien : Je leert van de specialisten om je heen én krijgt de vrijheid om je te ontwikkelen in de richting die bij jou past

Wil jij bijdragen aan een veerkrachtige jeugd in Amsterdam en omstreken? Sluit je aan bij ons team!

Als Systeemtherapeut bij Stichting JA! werk je met gezinnen die te maken hebben met complexe problematiek. Je staat midden in de leefwereld van gezinnen en bent daar waar het écht nodig is: thuis bij gezinnen, op school of in de wijk.

Je kijkt niet alleen naar het individu, maar naar het hele gezinssysteem en de bredere context. Samen met het gezin onderzoek je vastgelopen patronen en help je bij het herstellen van verbindingen en het versterken van veerkracht. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s in het gebiedsteam en draagt bij aan een warme, systemische aanpak waarin de cliënt centraal staat.

Waar kom je in dienst?

Iedereen die werkzaam is bij Stichting JA! is in dienst van een van onze moederorganisaties. Onze moederorganisaties zijn: FamilySupporters, Groei & Glunder, Timon, Terminal 18, Zigzag Kindzorg, Fibbe.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent een enthousiaste, positieve collega en je omarmt onze manier van werken;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met het werken met gezinnen die kampen met complexe problematiek en bent in staat ‘out-of-the-box’ oplossingen voor hen te creëren;
  • Je wordt enthousiast van outreachend werken, waarbij je midden tussen de gezinnen in de wijk staat;
  • Je bent een verbindende persoonlijkheid die in staat is integraal samen te werken; zowel met het systeem van het gezin, als met andere betrokken partijen, zoals het ouder- kindteam, buurtteam en jeugdhulpverleners van andere jeugdhulporganisaties;
  • Je vindt het leuk om jouw kennis over te dragen aan collega’s om met elkaar verder te ontwikkelen;
  • Je durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en bent initiatiefnemend;
  • Een afgeronde opleiding tot Systeemtherapeut;
  • Je bent in het bezit van een NVRG-registratie
  • Je bent in het bezit van een SKJ-registratie

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een gedreven, multidisciplinair team waar collegialiteit, overleg en van elkaar leren (casuïstiek, intervisie en werkbegeleiding) centraal staan.
  • Ruimte om zelf te blijven groeien als professional, door ervaring en door de opleidingsmogelijkheden die we bieden.
  • JA! organiseert vier keer per jaar inhoudelijke kennissessies met gastsprekers om de kwaliteit en inhoud van ons werk verder te versterken.
  • Een team waarin iedereen zich welkom en gezien voelt, ongeacht culturele achtergrond, religie of levensstijl.
  • De ruimte om jouw werkweek in te vullen op een manier die voor jou werkt;
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris en 8% vakantietoeslag;
  • Reiskosten vergoeding of een NS-businesskaart;
  • Een pensioenregeling bij pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn;
  • De ruimte om samen met bevlogen collega’s JA! verder te ontwikkelen en actief bij te dragen aan de toekomst van de jeugdhulp in Amsterdam.

Enthousiast geraakt?

Ben jij een Systeemtherapeut en word jij net zo enthousiast over de kansen en mogelijkheden binnen onze organisatie als wij dat zijn? Dan praten we graag verder! Stuur jouw CV naar of neem contact op voor een (verkennend) gesprek via of 06-40239002.

Fundado em 1962, na cidade de Itajaí, Santa Catarina, o Grupo Pereira tem como propósito "Ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, nos transformando, transformando as pessoas e o ambiente ao nosso redor".

Com 20 mil funcionários e 800 representantes comerciais autônomos nos estados de Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo e Distrito Federal, o grupo possui mais de 125 unidades de negócio, incluindo lojas do Comper, Fort Atacadista, Atacado Bate Forte, Broker, SempreFort, Pera Turismo e postos de combustíveis.

Além disso, oferece soluções logísticas com a Perlog e serviços financeiros com o Vuon, incluindo o private label Vuon Card, com mais de 1 milhão de cartões emitidos, além de seguros e assistência odontológica.

title: Analista Financeiro
description:
Responsável por gerenciar, monitorar e analisar dados financeiros da empresa para garantir o controle eficaz dos recursos, apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas e promover a sustentabilidade financeira do negócio. Atua em diversas frentes, como planejamento orçamentário, análise de investimentos, gestão de fluxo de caixa e controle de custos.

Atividades que desempenhará:

  • Orçamento
    • Controlar o desempenho financeiro em relação ao orçamento aprovado.
    • Identificar desvios e propor soluções corretivas.
  • Fluxo de Caixa
    • Controlar e projetar o fluxo de caixa da empresa.
    • Identificar necessidades de liquidez ou excedentes para aplicação financeira.
    • Assegurar o cumprimento de compromissos financeiros.
  • Indicadores Financeiros
    • Analisar KPIs financeiros, como margem de lucro, liquidez, endividamento e ROI.
    • Elaborar relatórios com insights financeiros e tendências de desempenho.
    • Apresentar os indicadores à CFO e propor melhorias.
  • Contas a Pagar e Receber
    • Monitorar vencimentos e realizar previsões de pagamentos e recebimentos.
    • Negociar prazos e condições de pagamento com fornecedores e clientes.
    • Garantir a eficiência nos processos de cobrança e pagamento.
  • Faturamento
    • Emissão de Notas Fiscais: Emitir notas de produtos/serviços com informações corretas e classificação tributária adequada.
    • Controle de Documentos Fiscais: Organizar, arquivar e conferir notas fiscais emitidas e recebidas.
    • Apuração de Impostos: Calcular tributos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e repassar dados fiscais à contabilidade.
    • Lançamentos no ERP: Registrar dados no sistema financeiro e integrar com contas a receber e estoque.
    • Gestão de Boletos e Cobrança: Gerar, enviar e acompanhar boletos bancários e inadimplências.
    • Conciliação Financeira: Verificar notas fiscais emitidas versus pagamentos recebidos e corrigir inconsistências.
    • Relatórios Gerenciais: Criar relatórios sobre vendas, receitas e tributos para suporte à gestão.
  • Conformidade e Auditoria
    • Assegurar que as práticas financeiras estejam em conformidade com regulamentações locais e internacionais (ex.: IFRS).
    • Atender as demandas das auditorias internas e externas.
  • Elaboração de Relatórios Gerenciais
    • Realizar os relatórios financeiros para subsidiar o controle de processos da área.
    • Alimentar os dashboards e painéis de controle para visualização de resultados financeiros.
    • Fornecer análises detalhadas para suporte à gestão.
  • Melhoria de Processos Financeiros
    • Revisar e otimizar processos financeiros para aumentar a eficiência.
    • Implementar ferramentas de automação e integração de sistemas.
    • Garantir a atualização e manutenção de sistemas ERP (ex.: SAP, TOTVS).

Requisitos para o Cargo

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças (desejável).

Experiência:

  • Experiência anterior em áreas financeiras, contábeis ou de controladoria.
  • Vivência em análise de investimentos e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Ferramentas financeiras: Excel avançado (VBA, Power Query), Power BI.

title: Senior Technical Analyst - Cyber Security
description:
Senior Technical Analyst - Cyber Security

Company: Ball Corporation

Location: SÃO Jose Dos Campos, São Paulo, BR, 12246-876

Date: Feb 20, 2025

Job Category: IT Administration

Req. ID: 41189

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Please, submit your resume in English .

Ball Corporation is looking for a well-rounded team player with broad technical leadership skills to add to our Global IT Security operations department. This position requires extensive knowledge in three or more of the following IT Security tools: Firewalls, Web Content Filtering, Web Application and Malware Protection, Intrusion Prevention System, SSL Decryption, Email Security, Strong Authentication, Remote Access, End Point Protection, Advanced Threat Management, Vulnerability Scanning & Remediation, Identity Management, Data Loss Prevention, Data Encryption, Security Incident Management, Public Key Infrastructure, Web Application Firewall, IT Security Forensics, Password Vaulting, Risk assessment, and security vulnerability assessment.

This position works within the Global IT Security team to solve complex IT Security problems by taking a broad perspective to identify innovative technical solutions. The successful candidate will provide mentorship and guidance to junior level cyber security analysts. The position also participates in managing our vendors to achieve the desired results including quality and on-time delivery. Working knowledge and relevant certifications in the above security tools is preferred.

Essential Responsibilities

  1. Security administration is a hands-on role that requires a high level of technical expertise including networking, operating systems, applications, cloud environments, and security.
  2. Responsible for a broad range of security tasks, including the day-to-day security administration of network security devices, as well as the management of technologies, such as firewall, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, data loss prevention, antivirus, anti-spam, antispyware, and security information and event management (SIEM) tools.
  3. Monitor, analyze, and respond to security incidents and breaches swiftly and effectively, minimizing potential impact.
  4. Lead incident response efforts, coordinate investigations, and ensure all incidents are properly documented and reported.
  5. Serve as a subject matter expert on cybersecurity matters, both internally and externally.
  6. Conduct regular security audits and assessments to identify weaknesses in networks, systems, and applications, and recommend remediation actions.
  7. Create and maintain system and network diagrams as well as process documentation.
  8. Provide support to ensure planning and deployment is accomplished in coordination with system owners, engineers, and stakeholders and are consistent with appropriate infrastructure and security engineering requirements.
  9. Assess and prioritize cybersecurity risks and vulnerabilities across the organization's technology landscape.
  10. Follow up on remediation of vulnerabilities.
  11. Participate in design and implementation of new security controls.
  12. Stay current with cybersecurity threats and trends, providing ongoing intelligence and insights to inform security decision-making.
  13. Create and modify procedural documentation as needed.
  14. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and frameworks, such as SOX, HIPAA, or NIST.
  15. Develop and maintain incident response plans, disaster recovery plans, and business continuity strategies to ensure resilience in the face of cybersecurity threats.
  16. Ensure that all information systems operate in accordance with set standards.
  17. Participate in an on-call rotation with the department.
  18. Establish and maintain effective working relationships within the department, the Strategic Business Unit, and the Company.

Main Requirements/Knowledge

  1. Advanced Level of English.
  2. Experience in a cyber-security operations environment including 4+ years of technical leadership.
  3. CISSP, CISM, CISA certifications preferred; other security relevant certifications considered.
  4. Knowledge of CISCO ASA solutions specifically remote access.
  5. Technical “hands-on” proficiency with at least three security-related systems and applications.
  6. Technical proficiency with security-related systems and applications, especially mainstream OS’s.
  7. Experience in documenting and maintaining processes and procedures.
  8. Knowledge of information security principles, including risk assessment, intrusion detection, and network access control.
  9. Knowledge of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPN, and associated network protocols and concepts.
  10. Knowledge of SANS Twenty Critical Controls information security policies, procedures, guidelines, and methodologies desired.
  11. A strong familiarity with cryptographic concepts and their practical application.
  12. Experience in securing Cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, SAP, etc.
  13. Knowledge and Understanding of the CI/CD Pipeline along with tools such as Jenkins and Bamboo.
  14. Experience in driving technology solutions in large, complex organizations.
  15. Proven focus in metrics-driven delivery: defining Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitoring SLAs, and enhancing environment to meet SLAs.
  16. Experience in driving process and technology re-engineering using industry practices.

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.

description:
Dirigir caminhão pipa, respeitando a legislação de trânsito e normas de tráfego, acionar comandos de tração, direção, hidráulicos, pedais e alavancas que movimentam os mesmos, para a execução dos serviços programados. Zelar pela conservação geral do veículo e registrar dados de manutenção e horas trabalhadas.

Conduzir o caminhão pipa, acionando comandos de tração, direção, hidráulicos, pedais e alavancas, manobrando-o corretamente, para a execução dos serviços programados, nas frentes de serviços, com prudência e atenção ao trânsito e ao painel, observando seu funcionamento e limites de exigência, de forma a prevenir acidentes e quebras que impliquem em danos à empresa e terceiros.

Atentar-se ao funcionamento dos itens do equipamento, utilizando mangueira de ar comprimido e kit de limpeza apropriado, bem como acompanhar os trabalhos de lubrificação e evitar o acúmulo de sujeira, de forma a mantê-los em perfeitas condições de funcionamento.

Executar a lavagem, conferência e troca de óleo, verificação do nível de água, lubrificação e substituição de filtros de óleo e de ar dos veículos e equipamentos, conforme o Plano de Manutenção.

Preencher diariamente relatório de produção, especificando o que foi feito, tempo de operação e de paradas, número de viagens e observações pertinentes, a fim de atender à exigência da contratante.

Solicitar manutenção e reparos dos equipamentos de produção, quando necessários.

Efetuar a verificação visual do estado geral de pneus e material rodante, analisando condições de funcionamento.

Preencher relatório de manutenção, informando os defeitos observados nos equipamentos, detalhando as falhas mecânicas, de forma a orientar os trabalhos de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, comunicando via rádio ou pessoalmente aos setores responsáveis.

Acompanhar atentamente os serviços de manutenção, lubrificação e abastecimento executados, verificando se estão sendo realizados corretamente, com o objetivo de preservar o patrimônio.
